heavy_handed.name: Heavy-Handed
heavy_handed.desc: You hit hard and without finesse. +4 melee and unarmed damage, but your critical hits are weaker.

twitchy.name: Twitchy
twitchy.desc: Nerves like a trip-wire. +5 initiative, but -10% to hit with ranged weapons.

bookish.name: Bookish
bookish.desc: You grew up in the Cistern library. +3 skill points per level, but -10% max health.

sweet_talker.name: Sweet-Talker
sweet_talker.desc: Words come easy. +15 Speech, but people who catch you lying never forget it (lies have harsher consequences).

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: You come alive after dark. +1 Senses and Wits at night, -1 during the day.

glutton.name: Glutton
glutton.desc: Food does more for you: +50% healing from food. You also need to eat twice as often.

cistern_pale.name: Cistern-Pale
cistern_pale.desc: Born under lamps. +10% to hit and +1 Senses indoors; -1 Senses and Reflex in open daylight.

one_hand.name: One-Handed
one_hand.desc: You favour one hand. +15% to hit with one-handed weapons, -40% with two-handed weapons.

old_debts.name: Old Debts
old_debts.desc: Someone owed you, or you owed someone. Start with extra supplies, but trouble comes looking later.

fast_metabolism.name: Quick Blood
fast_metabolism.desc: You heal fast (+2 healing rate), but chems wear off twice as quickly and radiation hits harder.

steady.name: Steady Hands
steady.desc: Slow and sure. +10% ranged hit chance and +1 crit chance, but -1 AP.

scrounger.name: Scrounger
scrounger.desc: You find more in every container, but merchants sense your hunger: buying costs 10% more.

cold_heart.name: Cold Heart
cold_heart.desc: Others' pain doesn't reach you. +10% damage with all weapons; companions trust you more slowly.

soft_touch.name: Soft Touch
soft_touch.desc: People open up to you (+affection gains), but you hesitate to kill: -10% hit chance against humans who are fleeing or begging.
